description: This file defines a generic Java class 'CachingClientFactory' that extends 'ClientFactory', implementing a cache for client instances with thread-safe creation, retrieval, and invalidation, including retry logic and liveness checks.

classes.name: CachingClientFactory
classes.description: A generic factory class that caches and manages client instances with thread safety, retry mechanisms, and health checks.

methods.name: CachingClientFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a Vertx instance and a liveness check predicate.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a client from cache based on key, optionally processing it with a handler.

methods.name: doClearState
methods.description: Clears all cached clients and creation locks.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the cache and creation locks are empty.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a cached client by key.

methods.name: getOrCreateClient
methods.description: Retrieves an existing client or creates a new one if none exists or if the existing one is not alive, with retry logic.
